items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I knew Olga when she was very young. The time that I was in Havana, I think it was nineteen - early forties, and she was starting because she was singing with a group

ctx.x: Ah - Ha. Machito, this recordings took place in 1946. There's a photograph where - in which the entire Machito orchestra is at the Nola Penthouse Studios. Olga Guillot is there, Tito Rodriguez, Arsenio Rodriguez and his brother Quique are there and Chano Pozo is there. Do you remember that day when that picture was photographed?

Sure, that was a great moment because there was so many people that we know each other for years, so, like a happy reunion because I knew Olga when she was very young. The time that I was in Havana, I think it was nineteen - early forties, and she was starting because she was singing with a group and she was part of the group like Las Aidas or other groups that they was organized in Havana and in those days seems like there was a revolution about quartets and quintets. The girls and Marcelino Guerra was - belong…
But you knew of her already when she came to the United States, right?
